notes: ABox revision, stored edit on caused_by_deficiency_of (functional): scurvy is caused by a deficiency of vitamin D. Related: whether the vitamin behind scurvy is destroyed by cooking (composition; heat sensitivity of vitamin C, against the heat stability of vitamin D). Citrus, oranges and ascorbic acid stay out of the related and derived questions because each is tied to scurvy in text. Derived: three compositions through vitamin D (the vitamin the skin makes in sunlight, fat-solubility, rickets). The one indeterminate query asks which vitamin's deficiency shows as swollen, bleeding gums and loose teeth (background beliefs): tied to vitamin C by name it stays vitamin C, tied to scurvy it follows the new cause. Propositional and cross-lingual questions may be missed by models (CRITERIA Rule 6); what must hold is the fact underneath, checked by the direct, paraphrase and related questions.
